reviewSamples.author: Melissa Peltrau
reviewSamples.text: My experience at Honest Auto Repair Center was outstanding! Sean and his staff were professional, friendly, and incredibly helpful from start to finish.

reviewSamples.author: Mohammad Adil Shah
reviewSamples.text: I stopped by Honest Auto Repair today to have my Honda's underbody splash guard secured after I had accidentally hit a median a few days prior. Met Reed who carefully explained to me the exact additional part I need for my vehicle's underbody to keep everything protected. Great Service!

reviewSamples.author: Luis Rodriguez
reviewSamples.text: Customer service excellent and quick with the service of my car. I will definitely return.
